description: explains which ADW workflow fits a job, how to start it, and what it changes, reading the ADW table of contents first
notes: Read-only on purpose: no Bash, Write or Edit, so it can explain an ADW but never run one -- several ADWs change the live books, and those are started by a person after EG approves. The table of contents at /home/adamsl/rol_finances/adws/ADW_TOC.md is the only file it reads in full; it then opens just the one ADW script's top docstring, so an answer never loads every ADW's details. output_path is a runtime scratch dir, not a deliverable. No ADW of its own: one lookup and one answer is not a repeatable multi-phase sequence.
